attchmntText: Deccan Cements Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Deccan Cements Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 22168.20 Lakhs. Standalone loss before tax was 1644.80 Lakhs. Standalone loss for the period was 1520.78 Lakhs. Basic earnings per share was negative 10.11. Consolidated revenue from operations was 22168.20 Lakhs. Total assets stood at 166387.83 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026. Total borrowings were 65367.03 Lakhs. The statutory auditors, M. Anandam and Co., issued a review report stating no material misstatements were found. Exceptional items included a reversal of provision for mineral bearing land infrastructure cess.
